name: Settlement-average lock-in taker
description: In the last 45 seconds before close, price the 60-second settlement average from Binance 1-second data (the part already fixed plus a random walk for the rest) and buy the 60-98c favourite when the model's probability beats the ask by 3c after fees. Kalshi's late quotes are wide and sometimes stale relative to the accumulated average, so a buyer who knows the average earns the difference.
hypothesis: Market makers in the last minute quote off the spot print and are uncertain how much of the average is fixed; quotes stay wide. Dev-data screen on 5 coins' trade prints: model probability >= ask+3c on a 60-98c favourite earns ETH +4.1c (CI wide of 0, 9/9 months), XRP +2.3c, DOGE +1.7c, SOL +3.2c per market. Wrong if engine fills (book depth, 150ms) kill it, or the full walk-forward is not promising / months flip as in settle-lockin's SOL.
